[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy dash attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.

origins.name: To Excess
origins.description: Final blows with this weapon while your Super is full grant a bonus to melee and grenade stat for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Jagged Edge
perks.description: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

enhanced.name: Jagged Edge
enhanced.description: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

perks.name: Enduring Blade
perks.description: Greatly increased sword ammo at the cost of damage.

enhanced.name: Enduring Blade
enhanced.description: Greatly increased sword ammo at the cost of damage.

perks.name: Swordmaster's Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has low overall defenses, but increases charge rate.

enhanced.name: Swordmaster's Guard
enhanced.description: Sword Guard has low overall defenses, but increases charge rate.

perks.name: Duelist's Trance
perks.description: Sword final blows grant increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.

enhanced.name: Duelist's Trance

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

enhanced.name: Relentless Strikes
enhanced.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.name: Valiant Charge
perks.description: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance.

enhanced.description: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance for an improved duration.

perks.name: Assassin's Blade
perks.description: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage.

enhanced.name: Assassin's Blade
enhanced.description: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Tireless Blade
perks.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.

enhanced.name: Tireless Blade
enhanced.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered Sword final blow, with a chance for additional ammo to be provided.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Counterattack
perks.description: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Counterattack
enhanced.description: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Whirlwind Blade
perks.description: Rapid sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for a short duration. Guarding also ends the effect.

enhanced.name: Whirlwind Blade
enhanced.description: Rapid Sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for an improved duration. Guarding ends the effect.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Harmony
enhanced.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for an improved duration.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie

enhanced.name: Adrenaline Junkie
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: One for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.
